column1: identify|v.|识别；确定|identify the cause|We need to identify the cause before changing the plan.|我们需要先确定原因，再修改计划。|The survey helps identify students who need extra support.|这项调查有助于识别需要额外支持的学生。
factor|n.|因素|a key factor|Cost is a key factor in the choice of materials.|成本是选择材料的一个关键因素。|The team considered every factor that could affect the result.|团队考虑了可能影响结果的每一个因素。
indicate|v.|表明；显示|indicate a change|The figures indicate a change in consumer habits.|这些数字表明消费者习惯发生了变化。|Please indicate which task you would prefer to complete first.|请说明你更愿意先完成哪项任务。
determine|v.|确定；决定|determine the outcome|Several conditions determine the outcome of the experiment.|若干条件决定实验的结果。|The researchers will determine how much water the plants need.|研究人员将确定这些植物需要多少水。
analyse|v.|分析|analyse the data|The students learned to analyse the data without ignoring exceptions.|学生们学会了分析数据，同时不忽略例外情况。|We should analyse the costs before buying new equipment.|购买新设备前，我们应该分析成本。

examine|v.|仔细检查；考察|examine the evidence|The committee will examine the evidence before making a decision.|委员会将在作出决定前仔细审查证据。|The course asks students to examine how cities use public space.|这门课要求学生考察城市如何使用公共空间。
investigate|v.|调查；研究|investigate a problem|An independent team will investigate the problem.|一个独立团队将调查这个问题。|The study aims to investigate why some people change their habits.|这项研究旨在探究一些人改变习惯的原因。
estimate|v.|估计；估算|estimate the cost|We can estimate the cost once the design is ready.|设计完成后，我们就能估算成本。|The researchers used photographs to estimate the size of the forest.|研究人员利用照片估算森林的面积。

finding|n.|研究发现；调查结果|a significant finding|One significant finding was that the two groups behaved differently.|一项重要发现是两组人的行为有所不同。|The new finding raises questions about the earlier explanation.|这一新发现使人们对先前的解释产生疑问。
conclusion|n.|结论|draw a conclusion|It is too early to draw a conclusion from one interview.|仅凭一次访谈就下结论还为时过早。|The report explains how the evidence supports its conclusion.|报告解释了证据如何支持其结论。
argument|n.|论点；论据|a convincing argument|Her argument is clear, but it needs stronger evidence.|她的论点很清楚，但还需要更有力的证据。|The article presents an argument for protecting local libraries.|这篇文章提出了保护当地图书馆的理由。

principle|n.|原则；原理|a basic principle|A basic principle of the project is to protect personal information.|这个项目的一项基本原则是保护个人信息。|The teacher used a simple example to explain the principle.|老师用一个简单例子解释这一原理。
concept|n.|概念；观念|an abstract concept|A diagram can make an abstract concept easier to understand.|图示可以让抽象概念更容易理解。|The book introduces the concept of shared responsibility.|这本书介绍了共同责任的概念。

phenomenon|n.|现象|a common phenomenon|Working from home has become a common phenomenon in some industries.|在一些行业，居家办公已成为一种普遍现象。|Scientists are trying to explain this unusual phenomenon.|科学家正在尝试解释这一不寻常的现象。
underlying|adj.|潜在的；根本的|the underlying cause|The meeting focused on the underlying cause of the disagreement.|会议重点讨论了分歧背后的根本原因。|A temporary improvement may hide an underlying problem.|暂时的好转可能掩盖潜在的问题。
assume|v.|假定；认为|assume that|We should not assume that everyone has reliable internet access.|我们不应假定每个人都有可靠的网络连接。|The model requires us to assume a constant temperature.|这个模型要求我们假设温度保持不变。
prove|v.|证明|prove a claim|One successful trial cannot prove that the method always works.|一次成功的试验不能证明这种方法始终有效。|The records may prove that the warning arrived too late.|这些记录可能证明警告来得太晚。
interpretation|n.|解释；理解|an alternative interpretation|Her interpretation of the results differs from mine.|她对结果的解释与我的不同。|The same sentence may allow more than one interpretation.|同一句话可能有不止一种理解。

cognitive|adj.|认知的|cognitive skills|The game is designed to practise basic cognitive skills.|这个游戏旨在训练基本的认知技能。|The researchers compared cognitive performance before and after the task.|研究人员比较了任务前后的认知表现。
perceive|v.|察觉；看待|perceive a difference|Listeners may perceive a difference that the device cannot measure.|听者可能察觉到设备无法测量的差异。|How people perceive a risk can influence their choices.|人们如何看待风险会影响他们的选择。

critical|adj.|批判性的；至关重要的|critical thinking|The course encourages critical thinking rather than simple repetition.|这门课鼓励批判性思考，而非简单重复。|Reliable records are critical to the success of the investigation.|可靠的记录对调查成功至关重要。

consensus|n.|共识；一致意见|reach a consensus|The group tried to reach a consensus on the main priorities.|这个小组努力就主要优先事项达成共识。|There is no consensus on the best way to measure this change.|对于衡量这一变化的最佳方法，目前尚无共识。
basis|n.|基础；依据|on the basis of|We revised the plan on the basis of new evidence.|我们根据新证据修改了计划。|Trust provides a basis for long-term cooperation.|信任为长期合作提供了基础。

perspective|n.|视角；看法|a different perspective|The interview gave me a different perspective on city life.|这次访谈让我从不同视角看待城市生活。|Try to consider the problem from the customer's perspective.|试着从顾客的角度考虑这个问题。
evaluate|v.|评价；评估|evaluate the results|The team will evaluate the results after three months.|团队将在三个月后评估结果。|We need clear criteria to evaluate the quality of the service.|我们需要明确的标准来评价服务质量。

economic|adj.|经济的；经济学的|economic growth|The report examines the link between education and economic growth.|报告考察了教育与经济增长之间的联系。|Economic change can create both opportunities and uncertainty.|经济变化既可能带来机会，也可能带来不确定性。

financial|adj.|财务的；金融的|financial support|The scholarship provides financial support for students from low-income families.|这项奖学金为低收入家庭的学生提供经济资助。|The company published a detailed financial report.|这家公司公布了一份详细的财务报告。

economy|n.|经济；经济体系|the local economy|Small businesses make an important contribution to the local economy.|小企业为当地经济作出了重要贡献。|The economy depends on a wide range of services and industries.|该经济体依赖多种服务业和产业。
industry|n.|产业；行业|the manufacturing industry|The manufacturing industry needs workers with practical skills.|制造业需要具备实践技能的工人。|Changes in technology are reshaping the travel industry.|技术变化正在重塑旅游业。
income|n.|收入|a regular income|A regular income makes it easier to plan household spending.|稳定收入使家庭更容易规划开支。|The survey compares income levels across different regions.|这项调查比较了不同地区的收入水平。

investment|n.|投资；投入|investment in education|Investment in education can take years to show results.|教育投入可能需要数年才能显现成效。|The project requires a larger investment than we first expected.|这个项目所需的投入比我们最初预期的更多。
profit|n.|利润；收益|make a profit|The shop made a small profit in its first year.|这家商店第一年获得了少量利润。|The report distinguishes total sales from actual profit.|报告区分了销售总额与实际利润。
demand|n.|需求|consumer demand|The factory adjusted production to match consumer demand.|工厂调整了生产，以适应消费者需求。|Demand for convenient transport is growing in the area.|该地区对便捷交通的需求正在增长。
supply|n.|供应；供应量|the water supply|The village needs a more reliable water supply.|这个村庄需要更可靠的供水。|A limited supply of skilled workers may delay the project.|熟练工人供应不足可能使项目延期。
policy|n.|政策；方针|public policy|Public policy can influence the choices available to families.|公共政策会影响家庭能够作出的选择。|The university introduced a policy to reduce unnecessary printing.|大学出台了一项减少不必要打印的政策。
government|n.|政府|local government|The local government asked residents for suggestions.|当地政府向居民征求建议。|The government plans to improve access to public services.|政府计划改善公共服务的可及性。

corporation|n.|大公司；企业|a multinational corporation|She joined a multinational corporation after graduation.|她毕业后加入了一家跨国公司。|The corporation must explain how it uses customer information.|这家企业必须说明它如何使用客户信息。
management|n.|管理；管理层|effective management|Effective management requires clear communication.|有效的管理需要清晰的沟通。|The management agreed to review the working conditions.|管理层同意重新审查工作条件。
efficiency|n.|效率|improve efficiency|The new system aims to improve efficiency without reducing quality.|新系统旨在提高效率，同时不降低质量。|Energy efficiency is an important feature of the building.|能源利用效率是这座建筑的重要特点。
incentive|n.|激励；刺激因素|a financial incentive|The company offers a financial incentive for useful suggestions.|公司为有价值的建议提供经济奖励。|A clear goal can provide an incentive to keep practising.|明确的目标能提供持续练习的动力。

employment|n.|就业；工作|employment opportunities|The new centre will create employment opportunities for local residents.|新中心将为当地居民创造就业机会。|The survey explores the relationship between education and employment.|这项调查探讨了教育与就业的关系。

production|n.|生产；产量|increase production|The factory cannot increase production without additional equipment.|没有额外设备，这家工厂无法提高产量。|Food production depends on both water and suitable land.|粮食生产同时依赖水和适宜的土地。

promote|v.|促进；推广|promote cooperation|The exchange programme aims to promote cooperation between schools.|这个交流项目旨在促进学校之间的合作。|Clear information can promote more responsible choices.|清晰的信息能够促使人们作出更负责任的选择。
compete|v.|竞争|compete for jobs|Graduates often compete for jobs that require similar skills.|毕业生常常竞争那些要求相似技能的岗位。|Small shops must find new ways to compete with large companies.|小商店必须寻找新的方式与大公司竞争。
potential|n.|潜力|realise one's potential|The training programme helps young workers realise their potential.|这项培训计划帮助年轻员工发挥潜力。|The study explores the potential of a simpler design.|这项研究探讨了一种更简单设计的潜力。
capacity|n.|能力；容量|production capacity|The factory plans to expand its production capacity.|这家工厂计划扩大生产能力。|The room has a maximum capacity of fifty people.|这个房间最多可容纳五十人。
recruit|v.|招聘；招募|recruit staff|The centre plans to recruit staff with different professional backgrounds.|中心计划招聘具有不同专业背景的员工。|We need to recruit volunteers before the event begins.|我们需要在活动开始前招募志愿者。
expense|n.|费用；开支|at great expense|The laboratory replaced the equipment at great expense.|实验室花费了很大一笔费用更换设备。|Rent is the largest monthly expense for many young workers.|房租是许多年轻员工每月最大的开支。

occupation|n.|职业；工作|a person's occupation|The form asks for each person's occupation and education level.|表格要求填写每个人的职业和教育程度。|Choosing an occupation involves more than comparing salaries.|选择职业涉及的不仅是比较薪水。

commercial|adj.|商业的；以营利为目的的|commercial activity|The old harbour has become a centre of commercial activity.|旧港口已成为商业活动中心。|The team considered whether the invention had commercial value.|团队考虑了这项发明是否具有商业价值。
artificial|adj.|人工的；人造的|artificial light|The experiment compared natural and artificial light.|实验比较了自然光和人工光。|The company is studying the limits of artificial intelligence.|这家公司正在研究人工智能的局限。

intelligence|n.|智力；智能|human intelligence|The course explores how human intelligence differs from machine performance.|这门课探讨人类智能与机器表现有何不同。|A single test cannot describe every aspect of intelligence.|单一测试无法描述智力的所有方面。

autonomous|adj.|自主的；自动运行的|an autonomous vehicle|An autonomous vehicle still needs careful testing before public use.|自动驾驶车辆在公开使用前仍需仔细测试。|The project studies how autonomous robots share a limited space.|这个项目研究自主机器人如何共用有限空间。
computer|n.|计算机；电脑|a computer system|The computer system stores the records in separate accounts.|这个计算机系统将记录保存在独立账号中。|The students used a computer to compare the images.|学生们用计算机比较这些图像。
database|n.|数据库|a research database|The research database contains records from several cities.|这个研究数据库包含多个城市的记录。|Only authorised users can change information in the database.|只有获准用户才能修改数据库中的信息。

hardware|n.|计算机硬件；硬件设备|computer hardware|The programme works on several types of computer hardware.|这个程序可在多种计算机硬件上运行。|Old hardware may need replacing before the software can be upgraded.|升级软件前，可能需要更换旧硬件。
equipment|n.|设备；器材|specialist equipment|The laboratory provides specialist equipment for student projects.|实验室为学生项目提供专用设备。|The equipment must be checked before each training session.|每次培训前都必须检查设备。

function|n.|功能；作用|a basic function|A basic function of the app is to save learning records.|这个应用的一项基本功能是保存学习记录。|The study asks how each part contributes to the function of the system.|这项研究考察各部分如何共同实现系统的功能。
design|n.|设计；设计方案|a simple design|A simple design can make a complicated tool easier to use.|简单的设计可以使复杂工具更容易使用。|The team changed the design after observing real users.|团队观察真实用户后修改了设计。
model|n.|模型；模式|a mathematical model|The mathematical model describes how information spreads.|这个数学模型描述信息如何传播。|The school is testing a new model of online teaching.|这所学校正在测试一种新的在线教学模式。
operate|v.|操作；运转|operate a machine|Workers must learn to operate the machine safely.|工人必须学会安全操作这台机器。|The device can operate for several hours without external power.|这个设备可以在没有外部供电的情况下运行数小时。

feature|n.|特色；功能|a useful feature|A useful feature of the website is its adjustable text size.|这个网站的一项实用功能是可以调节文字大小。|The report describes a feature that makes the two devices different.|报告描述了使这两台设备有所不同的一项特点。
communication|n.|沟通；通信|clear communication|Clear communication helps a team avoid repeated mistakes.|清晰的沟通有助于团队避免重复犯错。|The storm damaged the island's communication links.|暴风雨破坏了岛上的通信连接。
security|n.|安全；安全保障|data security|Data security matters even in a small research project.|即使在小型研究项目中，数据安全也很重要。|The building has improved security at its main entrance.|这座建筑加强了主要入口的安保措施。
screen|n.|屏幕|a computer screen|The results appeared on the computer screen within seconds.|结果在几秒钟内出现在电脑屏幕上。|The screen should remain readable in bright daylight.|屏幕在明亮日光下也应保持清晰可读。
remote|adj.|远程的；偏远的|remote access|Remote access allows the team to work from different cities.|远程访问让团队可以在不同城市工作。|The programme provides lessons for children in remote villages.|这个项目为偏远村庄的儿童提供课程。
automatic|adj.|自动的|an automatic update|An automatic update should preserve the user's existing records.|自动更新应保留用户已有的记录。|The doors have an automatic system that responds to movement.|这些门装有能感应移动的自动系统。

intelligent|adj.|智能的；聪明的|an intelligent system|An intelligent system should explain the limits of its suggestions.|智能系统应该说明其建议的局限。|The article asks what makes a machine seem intelligent.|这篇文章探讨什么会让机器显得智能。
researcher|n.|研究人员|an independent researcher|An independent researcher checked the original figures.|一位独立研究人员核对了原始数据。|Each researcher recorded observations in the same format.|每位研究人员都以相同格式记录观察结果。

scientist|n.|科学家|a leading scientist|A leading scientist explained why the experiment needed repeating.|一位杰出科学家解释了为什么需要重复实验。|The scientist carefully separated observation from speculation.|这位科学家谨慎地区分了观察与推测。

exposure|n.|接触；暴露|exposure to information|Repeated exposure to information does not always lead to understanding.|反复接触信息不一定会带来理解。|The study measured workers' exposure to loud noise.|这项研究测量了工人接触高强度噪声的情况。
content|n.|内容|online content|Students should check the source of online content.|学生应该核对网络内容的来源。|The editor revised the content to make the explanation clearer.|编辑修改了内容，使解释更加清楚。
broadcast|v.|播送；广播|broadcast a programme|The station will broadcast the programme on Friday.|这个电台将在周五播出该节目。|The team plans to broadcast the lecture for remote viewers.|团队计划向远程观众直播这场讲座。

influential|adj.|有影响力的|an influential report|The influential report changed the public debate about transport.|这份有影响力的报告改变了公众对交通问题的讨论。|A small group of influential users helped the idea spread.|一小群有影响力的用户帮助这一想法传播开来。

visual|adj.|视觉的|visual information|A diagram can present visual information more clearly than a long list.|图表可以比长清单更清晰地呈现视觉信息。|The study compares visual memory with memory for spoken words.|这项研究比较了视觉记忆与对口头词语的记忆。
carbon|n.|碳|carbon emissions|The city plans to reduce carbon emissions from transport.|这座城市计划减少交通产生的碳排放。|The class discussed how carbon moves through natural systems.|课堂讨论了碳如何在自然系统中循环。
greenhouse|n.|温室|a greenhouse experiment|The students grew vegetables in a small greenhouse.|学生们在一座小温室里种蔬菜。|The greenhouse experiment kept temperature and light under control.|温室实验控制了温度与光照。

agriculture|n.|农业|modern agriculture|Modern agriculture depends on reliable information about soil and water.|现代农业依赖可靠的土壤和水资源信息。|The region is looking for ways to support agriculture during dry seasons.|这个地区正在寻找旱季支持农业生产的方法。

chemical|n.|化学物质|a harmful chemical|The team checked whether the water contained a harmful chemical.|团队检查了水中是否含有某种有害化学物质。|Each chemical must be stored in a clearly labelled container.|每种化学物质都必须存放在标识清楚的容器中。
electricity|n.|电；电力|generate electricity|The new plant uses sunlight to generate electricity.|这座新设施利用阳光发电。|The village needs a reliable supply of electricity.|这个村庄需要可靠的电力供应。
preserve|v.|保护；保存|preserve a habitat|The project aims to preserve a habitat near the river.|这个项目旨在保护河流附近的一处栖息地。|The museum uses special methods to preserve old photographs.|博物馆使用特殊方法保存老照片。
threaten|v.|威胁；危及|threaten survival|Long dry periods can threaten the survival of young trees.|长期干旱会威胁幼树的生存。|The proposed road may threaten a rare animal's habitat.|拟建道路可能危及一种珍稀动物的栖息地。
harmful|adj.|有害的|harmful effects|The report examines the harmful effects of polluted water.|报告考察了受污染水体的有害影响。|Not every chemical is harmful at the same concentration.|并非每种化学物质在同一浓度下都有害。
reduction|n.|减少；降低|a reduction in waste|Better planning led to a reduction in food waste.|更好的规划减少了食物浪费。|The factory reported a small reduction in energy use.|工厂报告能源消耗略有下降。
protection|n.|保护；防护|environmental protection|Environmental protection is part of the region's development plan.|环境保护是该地区发展规划的一部分。|Young plants need protection from strong winds.|幼苗需要防护，以免遭受强风侵袭。

organism|n.|生物；有机体|a living organism|A living organism responds to changes in its surroundings.|生物会对周围环境的变化作出反应。|The scientists studied how one tiny organism survives in salt water.|科学家研究了一种微小生物如何在盐水中生存。
fertilizer|n.|肥料|organic fertilizer|The farmer tested organic fertilizer on a small area first.|这位农民先在一小块地里试用了有机肥料。|Too much fertilizer can affect water quality downstream.|过量施肥会影响下游的水质。

contaminate|v.|污染；使受污染|contaminate the water|Careless disposal can contaminate the water supply.|随意处置废物可能污染供水。|The containers were sealed so that dust could not contaminate the samples.|容器被密封，以防灰尘污染样本。
diverse|adj.|多种多样的|a diverse ecosystem|A diverse ecosystem contains many different forms of life.|一个多样化的生态系统包含许多不同的生命形式。|The project benefits from the team's diverse experience.|这个项目得益于团队多样化的经验。

boundary|n.|边界；界限|a natural boundary|The river forms a natural boundary between the two regions.|这条河构成两个地区之间的天然边界。|We need a clear boundary between public paths and protected areas.|公共步道和保护区之间需要明确的界限。
restrict|v.|限制|restrict access|The park may restrict access during the nesting season.|公园可能在筑巢季节限制进入。|The new rules restrict the use of certain chemicals.|新规定限制使用某些化学物质。

widespread|adj.|广泛的；普遍的|widespread concern|The proposal caused widespread concern among local residents.|这项提议引起当地居民的广泛担忧。|The species was once widespread but is now difficult to find.|这个物种曾经分布广泛，如今却很难找到。

catastrophe|n.|灾难；重大灾祸|an environmental catastrophe|Early warnings may help prevent an environmental catastrophe.|提前预警可能有助于避免环境灾难。|The report explains how poor preparation made the catastrophe worse.|报告解释了准备不足如何加剧这场灾难。
distribute|v.|分配；分发|distribute resources|The committee must distribute resources fairly.|委员会必须公平分配资源。|Volunteers will distribute drinking water after the storm.|暴风雨过后，志愿者将分发饮用水。

intensive|adj.|集约的；高强度的|intensive farming|Intensive farming can place pressure on local water supplies.|集约化农业可能给当地供水带来压力。|The trainees completed an intensive course in equipment safety.|学员完成了一门高强度的设备安全课程。
